cases.question: What role does T-cell count play in severe human adenovirus type 55 (HAdV-55) infection?
cases.complete: In our study, the only patient who recovered from severe infection had higher T-cell counts. Three of the five patients had relatively low T-cell counts when admitted. Our results suggest that these three patients may have been relatively immunocompromised and that a lower T-cell count may be a risk factor for HAdV-55 infection in young adults.
